verdict.rationale: Employment documentation is a fair axis for a startup-focused law firm, but the evidence pack never mentions preparing offer letters, employment agreements, or invention-assignment/confidentiality agreements. The ESOP/VSOP and employee-participation briefings cover employee equity, a related but different subject, and the IP/IT page covers asset building and transactions rather than hiring paperwork, so neither earns credit here.

support.subject: As a legal-ops lead, the firm prepares hiring paperwork — offer letters, employment agreements, and invention-assignment/confidentiality agreements — as part of a documented employment practice
